compatibility.notes: Tested baseline is Windows NVIDIA driver 566.14 on the recorded GPU, not a claim of the oldest usable driver. Header identity is from this archive's README; runtime encode acceptance is separate from GPU-free staging. Older drivers and other GPU models are not certified by this measurement. Installed and portable artifact acceptance remains a release gate.
